Resolves #3699

Updates `Neo.component.Carousel` (`src/component/Carousel.mjs`) so `createBaseItems()` and `onCarouselBtnClick()` work cleanly with `0`, `1`, `2`, or `3+` store records, including when items are added or removed dynamically on the fly or when an already-ready empty `Store` is bound initially or replaces a populated `Store`. Hides `.neo-carousel-btn-bar` (`removeDom = true`) when `store.getCount() < 2` or `autoRun > 0`, centers a single-item store in `neo-carousel-translate-x-0` (`positionIndex = 1`, `itemIndex = 0`), toggles active/inactive item classes directly when `store.getCount() === 2`, wraps `itemIndex` and `newRecordIndex` modulo `countItems` (`0 .. countItems - 1`) for `3+` items, keys `itemData` by `recordIndex` so `onItemClick` always fires the active middle record, and binds `load: me.onStoreLoad` directly in `afterSetStore`.

`agent-preflight`: not hosted here; baseline `PR Baseline` jobs run in CI.

Evidence: L2 (Playwright unit tests in `test/playwright/unit/component/Carousel.spec.mjs`) → L2 required (no structured ACs on #3699).

## AC Evidence
No structured ACs on #3699.

| Requirement (#3699) | Verification |
|---|---|
| Support 1 or 2+ items in `Neo.component.Carousel` | `test/playwright/unit/component/Carousel.spec.mjs` (`renders 1 item centered in neo-carousel-translate-x-0, hides nav buttons, and ignores rotation` & `renders 2 items, toggles the centered item on forward/back, and supports dynamic store removal and addition`) |
| Support removing and adding store items on the fly and binding ready empty stores | `test/playwright/unit/component/Carousel.spec.mjs` (`carousel.store.remove(...)`, `carousel.store.add(...)`, `carousel.store.clear()`, and `handles fresh empty config, initial ready empty Store, and replacing a populated Store with a ready empty Store`) |

## Deltas from ticket
- Passes `load: me.onStoreLoad` (function reference instead of string `onStoreLoad`) in `Carousel#afterSetStore` so `Observable#fire` does not walk `getController()` / `Neo.get(me.parentId)` on store loads, and invokes `me.onStoreLoad()` whenever `value || oldValue` is present so already-ready empty `Store` instances initialize/clear the track immediately.
- Keys `me.itemData[recordIndex] = data` and wraps `me.itemIndex` modulo `countItems` (`0 .. countItems - 1`) so `onItemClick` never reads `me.itemData[-1]` after wrapping past the end of the store.

### 🔬 Depth Floor
**Challenge:** The inherited `value?.getCount() > 0 && me.onStoreLoad()` guard prevents the new empty renderer from running when the assigned empty Store has already completed its load. This is not a general claim that all empty construction fails: the fresh-config controls pass after readiness.

Exact-head real-instance results:

| Path | Records | Slide texts | Navigation hidden |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Fresh empty config, await readiness | 0 | none | true |
| Populated ready Store control | 2 | A, B | false |
| Replace it with a Store already awaited through ready(), containing no records | 0 | **A, B remain** | **false** |
| Same instance, call existing onStoreLoad() | 0 | none | true |
| Initial assignment of an already-ready empty Store | 0 | none | **false** |
| Clear the same previously populated Store | 0 | none | true |

The failed replacement also retains itemData keys 0 and 1. The existing rendering method clears those correctly when called.

**Rhetorical-Drift Audit:** The zero-count claim needs this assignment-path repair. The controls concern VDOM/data projection, not browser-painted motion.

[RETROSPECTIVE] A future load event can initialize a new store, but cannot initialize a consumer attached after that event. The count guard hides the distinction.
